textRuns.value: EVERY number on this tab is a MODEL ESTIMATE — never an actual, never a management assumption, and never an input to the deterministic tabs 9-12 (a test proves those exports are byte-identical with or without this layer).

The eleven owner-approved models are trained on a labeled SYNTHETIC monthly history (seed 777, data/nfp/nfp_history*.csv) — the same placeholder discipline as the market data. At client cutover the identical code retrains on real history; only the data changes. Where a management assumption exists, the model estimate is shown BESIDE it so the two can be debated, not confused.
